name: Quess Corp Limited
about: Quess Corp Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides staffing and workforce solutions in India and internationally. It operates through four segments: General Staffing, Professional Staffing, Overseas Staffing, and Digital Platforms. The company offers general staffing, such as sourcing and recruitment, apprenticeship program, and center of experience; and flexi staffing, payroll and compliance management, apprenticeship solutions, gig workforce management, and workforce lifecycle services. It also provides professional staffing, including digital technology skills, GCC services, recruitment services, and mobility solutions; and niche talent acquisition, project staffing, contractual hiring, and specialist recruitment across technology domains, including AI, cloud, analytics, cybersecurity, and digital engineering. In addition, the company offers international staffing and workforce mobility solutions in APAC markets in engineering, healthcare, infrastructure, construction, hospitality, and services sectors through sourcing, deployment, and workforce management solutions. Further, it provides blue-collar job and HRMS platforms; and on-demand gig workforce platforms. Additionally, the company offers IT solutions comprising digital engineering, r and d solutions, managed services, managed capacity, staff augmentation, managed solutions provider, and hire-train-deploy and hire-deploy-train solutions; and RPO, executive search, and permanent recruitment services. The company was formerly known as Ikya Human Capital Solutions Limited and changed its name to Quess Corp Limited in January 2015. Quess Corp Limited was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, India.
